newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - News Corp eases after results.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - News Corp eases after results.

text.p: American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in Australian media group News Corp eased on Thursday after the company reported a lower-than-expected first-half profit.
News Corp preferred ADRs fell 1/2 to 16-3/4 on volume of 1.2 million shares, putting the company among on the ADRs' most-active list. Ordinary shares were off 3/8 to 20-3/4.

News Corp reported first-half net profit before charges and gains of A$731 million, just below analysts' expectations. However, the company said it still foresaw a 20 percent profit rise for the year overall.
British Sky Broadcasting Group rose 1-1/8 to 62-1/8 as investors responded to the company's expansion plans for digital television.
Vodafone Group Plc rose 1-7/8 to 46-5/8 amid speculation the British mobile telephone company could be the target of a takeover. A company spokesman denied it was a takeover target.

Latin American bellwether Telebras, Brazil's telecommunications holding, rose 7/8 to 88-1/4 after the nation's communications minister said the company would be broken up into four operating units for privatization. Telebras reported 1996 receipts rose 57.2 percent from the year before.
Decliners led advancers 221 to 266 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 39 million shares in early afternoon.
